messages:
maria gonzalez: hey all, first day here! quick one 44b I need access to eu-west1 for a perf run and to attach a billing account to a test project. who owns the eu billing account and what's the fastest path?

samir nadeem: welcome maria :tada: Finance manages the eu billing account (redwood-eu-sandbox). We normally create a project for new hires instead of touching org-level perms. Do you want us to create one?

maria gonzalez: yes please create a project. also need permission to deploy a small vm and call internal model endpoints. which roles should I ask for?

li wei: create project + link billing is easiest. We'll give you roles: Project Editor (or compute.admin + serviceAccountUser if more granular) and roles/iam.serviceAccountUser for the service accounts. For internal model endpoints you likely need network access to the cluster, so compute.networkUser on the host project if we attach subnets.

maria gonzalez: cool. also, I have to run some cross-cloud tests on AWS in eu-central. how do I get the cross-account assume role?

samir nadeem: we'll add you to the org cross-account role on eu-dev-001. You'll get an ARN like arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/OrganizationAccountAccessRole. infra-bot will open a request.

infra-bot: Access request created (#AR-5124) for maria gonzalez. Details: GCP - create project redwood-eu-mgonz + link to redwood-eu-sandbox billing; assign Project Editor on project. AWS - grant assume-role on eu-dev-001. Approvers: infra, finance. ETA: 1 business day.

maria gonzalez: brilliant, thanks! once it's ready, can someone post the exact assume-role command and the gcloud check I should run?

li wei: sure, when approved run:

```
# AWS assume example
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/OrganizationAccountAccessRole --role-session-name maria-session

# GCP check
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-eu-mgonz --flatten=\"bindings[]\" --format=\"json\"
```

samir nadeem: FYI if you need shared VPC attach perms we'll add compute.networkUser on the host project after you request it.

maria gonzalez: perfect, appreciate it. I'll wait for AR-5124 and follow up if anything errors out.

infra-bot: Reminder: please complete security training to unlock some infra approvals. (Sent to maria gonzalez).
